### Once in a Lifetime
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/once-in-a-lifetime-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-23.html
Passage: Luke 1:13, 17
Points:
- Zechariah received a rare honor when chosen by lot to burn incense before the Lord in the temple.
- The angel Gabriel appeared with the startling news that Zechariah and Elizabeth would bear a son named John.
- John was commissioned for a dramatic calling to prepare people's hearts for the coming Lord.
- Zechariah responded with doubt regarding his old age and was struck speechless until God fulfilled the promise.
- Every believer shares the unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime gift of being called into fellowship and service with God.
